citation.title: Four features of temporal patterns characterize similarity among individuals and molecules by glucose ingestion

population.description: Twenty healthy subjects (6 women, 14 men), Table 1; age and BMI as printed (mean ± SD, observed range). Recruited by snowball sampling; the paper does not state their nationality.

protocols.name: ogtt_75g
protocols.description: 75 g glucose solution (TRELAN-G75) ingested within a few minutes after a 10 h overnight fast, in the morning; read at 120 min

protocols.name: fasted
protocols.description: Fasting sample after the 10 h overnight fast, in the morning; short run-in. Methods: fasting samples were drawn twice before the load; Table 1 does not say whether its fasting value is the mean of the two or the 0 min sample, so it is entered as one fasted sample.

left_out.what: Glucose and insulin at the other 11 sampling times (10-240 min): plotted in Fig. 1 and Supplementary Fig. 1 / Supplementary Data 1, no table in the paper
Other molecules (free fatty acids, cortisol, total ketone bodies, amino acids, bile acids, pyruvate, growth hormone, active GIP, C-peptide) over 0-240 min: Fig. 1 and supplementary only
Water-ingestion control arm: only stated as showing no significant changes, no numbers (Supplementary Fig. 2b, Supplementary Data 1)
